_comment: Single source of truth for the depth and capacity policy shared by
the Python orchestrator and the Rust pool manager.
Both sides read this file at start-up and assert that their view
matches, so a change here can never leave the two implementations
disagreeing about which pools are deep enough.
Every threshold is denominated in the pool's own tokens or in raw
units. No USD value participates in an admission decision: the
fields below marked referenceOnly are human-facing observations and
tie-breakers only.
DEP-4.2: the depth bands are expressed in DECIMALS-NORMALISED
BINDING-SIDE capacity. A round-trip arbitrage needs BOTH sides of a
pool to absorb the position, so the binding side is the smaller of the
two one-sided capacities after each side is converted into its own
token units. The previous raw-unit bands (100 / 1_000 / 10_000) mixed
6-decimal and 18-decimal raw amounts in one comparison, which made them
dimensionally meaningless: measured against the 94 candidate pools they
classified 93 of them as `deep` and therefore discriminated nothing.
`minCandidateCapacityRaw` is retained as a raw-unit dust floor and as a
backward-compatible column value. It is NOT a depth band and never
gates an admission on its own.
`minCandidateBindingCapacity` is the admission floor in normalised
binding-side units: a pool must be able to absorb at least this much of
its weaker side within the epsilon price-impact budget.
R-11 (2026-11-12, 用户裁决): USDG 可视为与 USD 等价。
根因（务必分清）：作废的是『外部 fiat 价格源』，不是『美元』这个计价单位。
很多代币根本没有兑换渠道，任何外部 USD 价都取不到；
而 USDG 在绝大多数情况下有兑换渠道，所以 **USDG 取代 USD 承担计价作用**。
凡是以 USD 表述的经济量（经济下限、承载能力、名义价值、Gas 成本折算），
一律改用**同额 USDG** 表述——这不需要任何外部价格源。
USDG 是本链的计价资产与稳定币锚。经济学意义上 1 USDG == 1 USD，
所以任何以 USD 表述的经济量，都可以用同等的 USDG 数量表述，而
无需引入任何外部法币价格源（ETH 价、股票 USD 价、预言机报价）。
这条裁决解决的是『计价单位』问题，不是『深度信号』问题：
深度仍然是池子自身代币计量的链上价格冲击容量（见 depthBasis），
从未退化为任何 USD 阈值比较。
为什么这不违反 R-02『不得引入 fiat 价格源』：
R-02 禁止的是**外部**价格源（预言机、交易所指数价、人工报价）。
USDG 本身是本链上真实存在的计价资产，它与 USD 的锚定关系是
该资产的定义属性，不是需要额外喂价的数据源。
为什么这不违反 R-03『liquidity_index 不是深度信号』与 R-04
『不得依据 TVL 下架 token 对』：
两者继续成立。本裁决不把 USD 数值引入深度判据，也不允许任何
USD 数值（含 TVL）单独决定成员关系。
`pegRatio` 恒为 1。写成显式的数值而不是隐含假设，是为了让任何
使用该换算的地方都能在报告里落下一个可审计的比值字段，并且
让未来若锚定发生偏离时，代码会在**一个**地方显式失败，而不是
在散落各处的隐含换算里悄悄给出错误的答案。
`deviationToleranceBps` 是允许的偏离上限。0 表示不容忍任何偏离：
USDG 脱锚时，相关换算必须失败而不是继续输出近似值。
`allowedUses` 明确列举本换算可以进入的判据；不在列表中的用途
必须被拒绝，以免『USDG 等价于 USD』被逐步扩大成『可以引入
任意美元数字参与准入』。
VAL-4-12: the economic floor now lives here, next to the depth
thresholds, so the Python orchestrator, the Rust token manager and
this file cannot disagree about what a position has to be worth.
The thresholds are denominated in USDG, the venue's own quote asset,
NOT in USD. A USD threshold cannot express tradable value inside the
arbitrage environment, because 97.7% of the loops borrow stock
tokens that have no reliable on-chain USD price. USDG needs no
external price feed.
`minEconomicPositionUsdgRaw` answers 'how small a trade can be
worth doing?'. It is compared against the gas cost of the trade.
`minPoolDepthUsdgRaw` answers 'is this pool big enough to carry that
position?'.
These replaced the hardcoded 10 USDG constants that used to live in
`token_manager::usdg_economic::EconomicPolicy::default()`. The value
is unchanged; only its location moved. There is deliberately NO
second effective copy: the Rust side reads this file and asserts
its compiled view against it at start-up.

referenceOnly._comment: Observation-only values. They never gate an admission.

_bandCalibration._comment: How the band boundaries were derived. They are anchored on the position sizes the system actually attempts, not on percentiles of the pool population, so the bands describe what a position needs rather than how the population happens to be distributed.
_bandCalibration.shallowRule: a pool must be able to carry the smallest attempted position

measuredOnCandidatePools._comment: Measured with `pool-manager depth --dry-run --depth-scope candidate` against the 94 candidate-pool union on 2026-11-12. The counts are reproducible from `capacityBindingRaw` in the depth report and sum to the pool count.
